english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken rendering for discussing something from an anthropological perspective.

examples.english: Anthropologically, this wedding custom shows how a society maintains family ties.
examples.traditional: 從人類學嘅角度嚟睇，呢個婚禮習俗反映咗一個社會點樣維繫家庭。
